cards.front: Recall a key point about Waves
cards.back: Wave eqn: v = fλ; phase difference Deltaφ = 2piDeltax/λ = 2pift

cards.front: Recall a key point about Waves
cards.back: Superposition: y_total = y₁ + y₂; constructive: Deltaφ = 2npi; destructive: Deltaφ = (2n+1)pi

cards.front: Recall a key point about Waves
cards.back: Standing waves: nodes (A=0) at fixed ends; antinodes (A=max) at λ/4 intervals

cards.front: Recall a key point about Waves
cards.back: Double slit: fringe spacing w = λD/s; single slit: first minima at a sinθ = λ

cards.front: Recall a key point about Waves
cards.back: Polarisation: only transverse waves; Malus's law I = I₀cos^2θ

cards.front: Recall a key point about Waves
cards.back: Doppler: f' = f(v +/- v_o)/(v ∓ v_s) for sound; Deltaf/f = v/c for light (non-relativistic)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Waves
cards.back: TIR: occurs when n₁ > n₂ and θ > θ_c = arcsin(n₂/n₁); optical fibres use TIR

cards.front: Recall a key point about Waves
cards.back: Refractive index: n = c/v = c₁/c₂; Snell: n₁sinθ₁ = n₂sinθ₂
